text: Tier mapping: legacy era n is LOOP_V2 Tech n-1 (eras start at 1, :701), and a legacy tier-t unit or vehicle is buyable at era t (:1178, :1358), so the legacy T2 items (the Officer class and the Juggernaut vehicle) unlock after one era-up, where LOOP_V2 §4 puts them at Tech 2, two steps up, and spends Tech 1 on class abilities, which legacy never gates (useAbility :1374-1375 checks no era). Pace, an estimate from run totals rather than a measured era-up time (docs/reports/2026-10-16-three-teams-core.md:44, DM_Tri 3 x 300 s): a team earns about 50 tech per 300 s from trucks (10 deliveries x 5), at most 20 from the two tech-box cash-outs at 128 s and 254 s (first 8 s plus active 120 s, gap 6 s), and 3 to 16 from kills (3-8 kills per team per run, 1 tech per kill, 2 per headshot, :1523), so the first era-up (60 tech, :699) lands at roughly minute 4 to 6, close to the LOOP_V2 §4 minute-5 Tech 1 floor, which legacy does not have.

The tech half of the rule does not carry over as a kept rule: the x0.5 tech cut (:2434, in addTech) modifies legacy tech sources (trucks, tech boxes, kills) that LOOP_V2 §4 replaces with uplinks, and §3 keeps only the price rise. Whether a dead plant should also slow tech is a LOOP_V2 question for Mustafa (see GE4), not a legacy rule to port.
